summary.publish: geometry safe: pars, routing, greens and tee positions are right on all 18 holes for the yardages the page states, and qa_page.js finds 0 problems. Two Blue calm picks are bad tee-shot advice (1: 4-wood into the lake edge; 16: Driver into the trees left of the dogleg). The tee-set NAMES may be shifted one set (club card unconfirmed). Keep published with that caveat; do not call it hand-checked.

course_notes: qa_page.js re-run 2026-10-30 on Gold and Blue: 18 holes, 0 problems each (only a sandbox cert console error).

All 18 holes drawn on the page photo with OSM greens, hole lines, all four tee sets and the calm landing spot. Every hole routes correctly; greens are the OSM greens; pars 5 4 4 3 4 3 4 4 5 / 3 5 4 4 4 3 5 4 4 = 72 agree on both cards.

Page tees mostly come from 'tee_axis' (slid along the tee box axis to hit the card yardage), so measured-vs-card agreement is by construction; the tee positions sit on or next to real OSM boxes on every hole (Gold 1 is a lidar pad under trees behind the Blue box).
Request asked for 'Black' (not on the card); build substituted Gold.

holes.notes: Routing, green, par 5 OK. Page Gold tee is a lidar pad under trees ~25 yds behind the Blue box (18 yds from the nearest OSM box; 514 vs card 510), plausible for a back tee but unconfirmed. Page Blue calm pick is 4-wood +1 landing 285 yds out at the edge of the lake that crosses the fairway (rough, pattern 36% water; page QA flagged it). That is a bad tee-shot recommendation: the fairway ends at the lake ~280 yds from the Blue tee, so the play is a club that stays ~250 or shorter. Gold pick (2-wood -10, 295 from 25 yds further back, fairway) is fine. Needs a solver re-check / rebuild; no geometry fix.
